summary: First full-stack test of Vaka dental virtual-patient simulator. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass covering /api/cases (TR/EN + spoiler-free detail), session lifecycle (create, message with LLM patient reply + transcript persistence, exam, test with x-ray, xray-answer correct/wrong, commit, score with all fields), empty-session score robustness, x-ray flow for all 4 cases, and /api/demo. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright run of the full user journey succeeded — 4 case cards render, TR/EN toggle works, demo link present, briefing→simulation nav, chat send returns patient bubble, phase stepper switches through Anamnez/Muayene/Testler/Tanı/Tedavi, exam pill returns result and tooth-46 highlights on odontogram, radiographic test renders xray-image with real src, xray option click shows correct/incorrect + xray-explanation, dx/tx selection then end-encounter navigates to debrief showing total-score (66), per-dimension bars, red flags, examiner narrative, and copy-summary/home/retry buttons; footer disclaimer visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L25: LLM_MODEL = ("gemini", "gemini-3-flash-preview") — 'gemini-3-flash-preview' looks non-standard; if the emergentintegrations client rejects it the code silently falls back to a canned reply. Verify the model id is valid (likely should be 'gemini-2.5-flash' or similar) so real AI dialogue works. Currently tests still pass because /message returns a fallback string; the LLM narrative in /score also silently falls back.
server.py L296: return type annotation '(str, Dict[str, str])' is a tuple literal, not a valid typing tuple — harmless at runtime but misleading; use Tuple[str, Dict[str, str]].

cases_seed.py: hidden_facts use Turkish keywords with special chars (ı, ç etc.) but norm() strips them via translate; verify that anamnesis red-flag detection works for both TR and EN keyword variants (spot check passed for 'gece', 'soğuk').
Score fallback narrative works but the /message and /score both depend on the same possibly-broken LLM model id — user-visible impact is bland responses if LLM_MODEL is invalid.
seed_data_creation: Sessions created dynamically via API; no manual DB seeding needed (cases seeded in code).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Route is /sim/{id} (not /simulation/{id}). All expected data-testid attributes are in place. LLM patient replies work (real reply observed in Turkish). Verify LLM_MODEL id in /app/backend/server.py L25 if AI replies degrade — currently 'gemini-3-flash-preview' which may need updating.
